correctness.rationale: Two differently structured exhaustive computations from H(5,2) incidence and P(10,3) edge definitions agree on all 155 exactly matching minimum masks after a verified 20-vertex isomorphism; they independently rule out every smaller mask and compute 750 two-exchange pairs with radius/diameter four. The incidence code verifies 240 automorphisms, orbit sizes 5,30,120 and every edge of an explicit complete finite certificate. The monotonicity lemma is elementary and the four-move construction is valid for every two-exchange pair. Capacity nine cannot connect minima as none are one-exchange adjacent, while a disjoint pair forces sixteen moves at capacity ten. No unsupported infinite extension.

value.rationale: Natural operational reconfiguration of secure guard placements reveals a sharp two-spare-guard threshold despite every minimum placement supporting one-off defensive responses. The full 155-set symmetry decomposition, frozen one-exchange optima and exact distance16 form nontrivial structural classification and answer a motivated configuration-stability problem beyond a scalar invariant.
